item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate to use a typed status throughout. Add src/status.rs with public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) -> &'static str returning exactly the existing lowercase names, Display with the same output, and FromStr with type Err = ParseStatusError; make ParseStatusError public, implement std::error::Error, and ensure its message names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for precisely pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus and re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root. Replace status string comparisons/assignments throughout production code with enum values; status-name string literals should appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly, including error text, report output and sorting/ordering, and parsing behavior. Update/add tests as needed, run cargo test successfully, and commit the completed change. Do not push or merge.
